# Pull Request - LoopDev v2

> The title must follow `type(scope): imperative description`.

## Objective

Describe the problem this PR solves and the observable result.

## Change type

- [ ] New functionality (`feat`)
- [ ] Bug fix (`fix`)
- [ ] Tooling, documentation, or refactor (`chore`)
- [ ] Test or validation infrastructure (`test`)
- [ ] Governance or protocol change

## Area

- [ ] CRM
- [ ] Communications
- [ ] Platform
- [ ] Design system
- [ ] Documentation or governance

## Validation

- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Typecheck passes
- [ ] Build passes
- [ ] Documentation is updated when contracts change
- [ ] The change does not bypass adapter, tenant, or permission boundaries

## Reviewer notes

Describe important decisions, contracts, migrations, RLS, secrets, or
integrations that deserve focused review.

## Risks

Describe known risks, limitations, or accepted debt.

## Issue

Closes #
